title: Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar (Nintendo Switch)

comparisons.notes: SKU 6625974 confirms the exact item (Nintendo Switch, physical). $29.99 and in-stock status from a live price tracker for this SKU.
Nintendo Switch version, UPC 850062242265 and part number 82526 match, $29.99, in stock. Page notes it may not include original box or manual.

writeup: Woot has Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar for Nintendo Switch, new and physical, for $14.99. The 2025 remake of the farming sim scored 81 on Metacritic and gives you your own weekly bazaar stall to sell your harvest. Best Buy and GameStop both charge $29.99, so this is half off. Woot showed only one left, limit one per customer.
